name: The St. Regis Atlanta
positioning: St. Regis hotel in Atlanta's Buckhead district, home to the Michelin-starred Atlas restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a Buckhead base a short walk from Buckhead Village
Diners drawn to Atlas and its 20th-century art

facts.text: The hotel is at Eighty-Eight West Paces Ferry Road in Atlanta's Buckhead district.
Buckhead Village is a 5-minute walk, about 0.2 mile, from the hotel.
The St. Regis Atlanta earned a Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star rating for 2026.
Atlas holds a 2025 MICHELIN One Star.
Astor Court serves seasonal and traditional favorites along with contemporary Southern selections.
The St. Regis Bar has a terrace with seating along a fireplace.
The Garden Room is a garden bar and fine dining venue.
Rooms have five-fixture white marble bathrooms and smart room controls by iPad.
St. Regis Butlers are available any time, day or night, for packing, unpacking, shoe shines and garment pressing.
The Athletic Club is on the 7th floor and is complimentary to all hotel guests.
The Spa at The St. Regis Atlanta received a Forbes Four-Star rating.
The lobby has hardwood floors, dual curved staircases and chandeliers.

highlights.text: Atlas has emerald-green walls covered in 20th-century art, including works by Foujita, Chagall, Monet, Soutine and Picasso.
A champagne sabering ceremony is hosted daily at 6:00 PM on the fourth floor.
The hotel offers complimentary transportation with a driver and a luxury car within a two-mile radius.
Afternoon Tea, which combines tea with live entertainment, takes place in Astor Court on Saturdays and Sundays.
The 3,000-square-foot Empire Suite has its own private gym with a Peloton bike.

considerations.text: The Pool Piazza is open during the summer.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
